YZE.Name: Name
YZE.SeedCoreSkillsHint: Adds the 12 core skills from the Year Zero Engine SRD as skill items.

CoreSkillDesc.force: Lift, push, or break heavy obstacles; feats of raw strength.
CoreSkillDesc.melee: Fight hand-to-hand or block attacks in close combat.
CoreSkillDesc.stamina: Physical endurance, surviving underwater, resisting poison/disease, and Death Saves.
CoreSkillDesc.mobility: Speed and motor control: risky climbs, jumps, retreats, and foot/vehicle chases.
CoreSkillDesc.stealth: Sneak undetected, hide, or perform sneak attacks (opposed by Observation).
CoreSkillDesc.crafting: Repair broken gear or vehicles and build or operate mechanical constructions.
CoreSkillDesc.observation: Spot approaching threats or examine an area for clues.
CoreSkillDesc.survival: Navigate, make camp, forage, hunt, and fish in hazardous environments.
CoreSkillDesc.healing: Help broken characters recover and stabilize lethal critical injuries.
CoreSkillDesc.insight: Read NPC emotions, detect lies, and resist Persuasion or stressful situations.
CoreSkillDesc.persuasion: Convince, trick, or interrogate others without violence (opposed by Insight).

r6.title: Keeping it Together
r6.effect: You manage to keep your nerves in check. Barely.

r7.title: Nervous Twitch
r7.effect: You and all PCs in Short range gain a stress point.

r8.title: Tremble
r8.effect: You tremble uncontrollably. All skill rolls using Agility suffer a −2 modifier.

r9.title: Drop Item
r9.effect: You drop a weapon or other important item – the GM decides which one.

r10.title: Freeze
r10.effect: You’re frozen by fear or stress for one round, losing your next turn.

r11.title: Seek Cover
r11.effect: You must use your next action to move away from danger and find a safe spot if possible. You lose 1 stress point, but all other PCs in Short range gain 1 stress point.

r12.title: Scream
r12.effect: You scream for one round, losing your next turn. You lose 1 stress point, but every PC who hears your scream must make an immediate panic roll.

r13.title: Flee
r13.effect: You must flee to a safe place and refuse to leave it. You lose 1 stress point, but every PC who hears your scream must make an immediate panic roll.

r14.title: Berserk
r14.effect: You must immediately attack the nearest person or creature, friendly or not, until you or the target is broken. Every PC who witnesses your rampage must make an immediate panic roll.

r15.title: Catatonic
r15.effect: You collapse to the floor and can’t talk or move, staring blankly into oblivion.

MagicMishap.r1: The magic makes you unable to sleep for D6 days.
MagicMishap.r2: Your spell drains your energy, inflicting one point of stress.
MagicMishap.r3: Your magic hurts your body and you suffer one point of damage.
MagicMishap.r4: The spell triggers a magical disease with a virulence of 2D6. You and everyone within Engaged range for the next shift are exposed.
MagicMishap.r5: The spell also affects a friend or other unintended victim.
MagicMishap.r6: Your magic permanently alters your appearance. The GM decides how.
MagicMishap.r7: The spell blinds you. You act as in total darkness for the next full day.
MagicMishap.r8: The spell ravages your mind. Immediately roll for a mental critical injury.
MagicMishap.r9: The force of the magic breaks bones in your body. Immediately roll for a physical critical injury.
MagicMishap.r10: Your magic attracts a demon from another dimension. The demon appears within the next shift.
MagicMishap.r11: The spell backfires. An offensive spell affects you instead of your intended target; a healing spell wounds instead of healing.
MagicMishap.r12: Your magic rips open a rift to another dimension, and a demon pulls you over to the other side. Your character returns as an NPC after D66 days… changed.

14.name: Sprained ankle
14.effects: Mobility −2 and movement is a slow action until a Healing roll is made.

15.name: Blood in eyes
15.effects: Observation and Marksmanship −2 until a Healing roll is made.

32.name: Crotch hit
32.effects: One point of damage for every Mobility or Melee roll made.

45.name: Bleeding gut
45.effects: One point of damage for every Mobility or Melee roll made.

51.name: Busted kidney
51.effects: Mobility −2 and movement is a slow action.

56.name: Cracked spine
56.effects: Paralyzed from the neck down. If no Healing roll is made in time, the effect is permanent.

66.name: Impaled heart
66.effects: Your heart beats for the last time.

32.name: Nightmares
32.effects: Make an Insight roll every shift spent sleeping. Failure means the sleep doesn’t count.

36.name: Nocturnal
36.effects: You can only sleep during the light part of the day.

42.name: Phobic
42.effects: You are terrified by something related to what broke you. Suffer 1 stress/Wits damage each round within Short range.

44.name: Alcoholic
44.effects: You must drink alcohol every day, or suffer 1 stress/damage to Agility.

46.name: Claustrophobic
46.effects: Every stretch in a confined environment, you suffer 1 stress/damage to Wits.

52.name: Mythomaniac
52.effects: You cannot stop yourself from lying about everything.

53.name: Paranoia
53.effects: You are certain that someone is out to get you.

55.name: Delusion
55.effects: You are totally convinced of something that is totally untrue.

56.name: Hallucinations
56.effects: Make an Insight roll every shift. If you fail, you suffer a powerful hallucination.

61.name: Altered personality
61.effects: Your personality is altered in a fundamental way.

63.name: Amnesia
63.effects: You lose all memory, and cannot recollect who you or the other PCs are.

64.name: Catatonic
64.effects: You stare blankly into oblivion, and do not respond to any stimuli.

66.name: Heart attack
66.effects: Your heart stops, and you die of pure fright.

r1.name: Ricochet
r1.effects: The attack bounces off the vehicle and strikes another random target in the same zone, inflicting the same damage.

r2.name: Skid
r2.effects: The vehicle skids severely. The driver must make an immediate skill roll (not an action) – failure loses their next turn.

r3.name: Windshield Shattered
r3.effects: The windshield is shattered, reducing Maneuverability by one step.

r4.name: Driver Hit
r4.effects: The driver is hit and suffers damage equal to the damage inflicted on the vehicle.

r5.name: Passenger Hit
r5.effects: A random passenger is hit and suffers damage equal to the damage inflicted on the vehicle, plus a critical injury.

r6.name: Wheel Blown
r6.effects: A wheel or thruster is blown out, giving a −2 modifier to all driving skill rolls.

r7.name: Severe Spin
r7.effects: The driver must make an immediate skill roll – failure means the vehicle crashes and is automatically wrecked.

r8.name: Fuel Fire
r8.effects: The vehicle catches fire. Everyone inside is exposed to intensity 6 (C) fire.

r9.name: Weapon Disabled
r9.effects: A random weapon mounted on the vehicle is disabled.

r10.name: Massive Crash
r10.effects: The vehicle careens out of control and crashes violently. Automatically wrecked; passengers suffer D6 falling damage.

r11.name: Engine Disabled
r11.effects: The engine is disabled, and the vehicle can’t continue.

r12.name: Explosion
r12.effects: The vehicle explodes in a ball of flame! Everyone inside is exposed to a blast power 9 (B) explosion; vehicle destroyed beyond repair.

Menu.name: Year Zero Engine World Rules
Menu.label: Configure YZE Rules
Menu.hint: GM-only menu to configure core dice mechanics (Dice Pool vs Step Dice) and modular Year Zero Engine rules for this world.
Menu.title: Year Zero Engine — World Rules Configuration
Menu.BalanceWarningText: Choose between Dice Pool and Step Dice when first setting up your table. Players cannot change this mode, and switching it during an ongoing campaign is strongly discouraged because attribute scales, skill ratings, derived Health/Resolve, carry limits, armor ratings, and modifiers are balanced differently between both systems.
Menu.ModeChangePendingNotice: You are about to change the world's core dice system. You will be asked to confirm the balance impact before saving.
Menu.ConfirmModeChangeBody: Are you sure you want to switch this world from {from} to {to}? Changing the dice system mid-campaign can cause severe rule and character balance issues, and existing character sheets may need manual re-calibration.
Menu.Saved: Year Zero Engine world rules saved.
Menu.GMOnlyError: Only the Gamemaster / world owner can change Year Zero Engine world rules.

resolutionMode.name: Core Dice Mechanics
resolutionMode.hint: Choose between Dice Pool (pools of D6s, ratings 1–5) and Step Dice (polyhedral dice D6/D8/D10/D12, ratings D–A). Only the GM can set this option.

stepModifierMode.name: Step Dice Modifier Style
stepModifierMode.hint: Choose whether modifiers in Step Dice mode step dice up/down (SRD p. 10) or grant Advantage/Disadvantage (SRD p. 11).

damageMode.name: Damage & Trauma System
damageMode.hint: Choose how damage and trauma are tracked (SRD p. 5 & 20–21).

pushMode.name: Cost of Pushing
pushMode.hint: Choose what happens when a player pushes a roll (SRD p. 9).
pushMode.attributeDamage: Attribute Damage (+1 Willpower Point per Bane + Gear Degradation)
pushMode.stressDice: Stress Dice (+1 Stress Point on push; 1s trigger Panic Roll)
pushMode.conditions: Conditions (Suffer a Physical or Mental Condition on push)
pushMode.doomPoints: Doom Points (GM gains +1 Doom Point on push)

enableWillpower.name: Enable Willpower Points (WP)
enableWillpower.hint: Show Willpower Points on character sheets (used for Magic and Willpower Specialties).

enableStressTrack.name: Enable Stress Track & Panic
enableStressTrack.hint: Show Stress Points and add Stress Dice to skill rolls (horror variant, SRD p. 9–10).

enableEncumbrance.name: Enable Encumbrance Tracking
enableEncumbrance.hint: Track carried item weights against the character's carry limit (SRD p. 6).

weaponsAtHandRule.name: Weapons at Hand Variant
weaponsAtHandRule.hint: Up to 3 weapons marked 'At Hand' and worn armor do not count toward encumbrance (SRD p. 6).

autoSeedCoreSkills.name: Auto-Add 12 Core SRD Skills
autoSeedCoreSkills.hint: Automatically add the 12 core YZE SRD skills as skill items when creating a new Character or NPC.

doomPoints.name: GM Doom Points
doomPoints.hint: Current pool of GM Doom Points accumulated from pushed rolls.
